name: job-search-strategy
description:
Builds a structured job search plan including target role definition, company
tier list, application volume targets, outreach strategy, and a weekly activity
schedule. Produces a complete, actionable search plan the user can execute
immediately. Use when the user wants to organize their job search, create a
job hunt plan, set application targets, or structure their weekly search
activities. Do NOT use for resume writing (use resume-bullet-writer), interview
preparation (use behavioral-interview-prep or technical-interview-prep), or
career pivot planning (use career-pivot-roadmap in career-development).
